decision: JFC 2026-10-05: shell freeze lifted; approved capabilities must not regress without an explicit product decision.
coverage: Initial protected inventory. Passing these tests is not proof of complete UI/UX coverage or physical-device health.

capabilities.contract: Any money view with a balance due (Commissions by product incl. product sheet, Commissions by rack, Customers fiado incl. Pending payment filter, dashboard commissions) shows a visible, enabled, 44px+ control in the active language to record that payment, also with integrity pending.
Earned/Paid/Still due, partial payments, statements, history, person and shelf editors and historical deep links remain reachable.
The four monthly commission totals open readable breakdowns; product/person editors and explicit period payment routes remain usable in EN/ES, Chromium and WebKit.
Both product/SKU and rack/event views remain available.
Selected period survives dashboard-to-app payment navigation.
Counter is a sales channel, never implicit removal of the piece/shelf commission.
New payments are exact, auditable facts; partial payments, retries and legacy history remain coherent.
Split and return adjustments preserve paid history.
Archived or deleted shelves do not reappear from stale peers.
Rendering preserves photos; recovery uses exact shelf evidence and respects newer images.
Exports are importable and preserve photo evidence; corrupt imports do not erase business state.
Business edits converge without mixing tenants or applying operations twice.
Stale legacy zero cannot erase valid positive stock; legitimate modern zero remains supported.
Undo and returns preserve the existing accounting and stock semantics.
Changing display language does not overwrite the user's business name.

El dinero se deriva en tres capas (hechos, libro de doble entrada, vistas): cada asiento suma cero, el saldo de 2000 por persona = Pendiente al centavo, el libro es determinista e idempotente (ADR-001).

Paid sale cancellation remains recoverable in later periods; legacy payments, consumption and reversals remain coherent. Exported payouts use backwards-readable item kinds and preserve the logical recovery identity.

Commission payments, reversals and legacy multi-person batches confirm complete durable storage before success or sync notification. Failed attempts restore financial facts and preserve photo evidence; retries remain idempotent.
Payment controls announce full/partial choice in EN/ES before clicking; partial payments refresh the local dashboard to the same cents without changing stock or losing period links.
Local device nickname edits report immediately; passive checkins cannot rewind confirmed business/device names from stale KV into the fresh registry; folded device nicknames remain searchable.
The PIN badge describes the controlling worker, not whichever cache is newest.

An activated business, including lord, starts and stays empty when it has no owner-created records. Optional sales demo remains separate. Exact historical demo fingerprints are excluded from app/dashboard/shared catalog without deleting recoverable storage or real transaction history. No sample-rack label or workaround copy is imposed on business data.
